import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,subprocess,sys,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path.cwd();o=json.loads((p/'search-budget.json').read_text());q=['"Smith normal form" "extended Dynkin" conjecture','"KSTH" conjecture spanning trees','"Spinning switches" "minimal" surjective strategy'];o.update(batch=2,queries=q,charged_ids=[355860,356278,356493],used_batches=2,used_queries=6,remaining_batches=1,remaining_queries=3,actual_summary='pending native call2; call1 completed');assert o['used_batches']<=3 and o['used_queries']<=9
for n in ['search-budget.json','search-plan-batch2.json']:
 assert n=='search-budget.json' or not (p/n).exists()
 z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=json.dumps(o,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
seed=p.parent/'expanded-corpus-r393/chronology-registry.json';s=json.loads(seed.read_text());print('REGISTRY SEED',json.dumps(s)[:18000])
